title_direction: working direction about a shield extended across borders
unlock_conditions: protect at least 8 independent African states, win or settle every protection war, keep all 8 alive and outside direct annexation until Africa is one
disqualifying_conditions: directly annexing any counted state before unification, breaking a counted guarantee, forced scenario launch
tracking_requirements: count unique protected partners and broken-guarantee flags
icon_direction: open shield around several distinct state seals
design_value: rewards the opening fantasy without map painting

title_direction: working direction about relief arriving through a closing corridor
unlock_conditions: complete an aid corridor to a partner below 20 percent surrender progress remaining, prevent capitulation for 180 days, then end its colonial war in victory or negotiated independence
disqualifying_conditions: partner capitulates, corridor abandoned, direct annexation before peace
tracking_requirements: record target surrender state at mission start and survival window
icon_direction: train and ship entering a defended gate
design_value: turns a near-defeat rescue into a remembered campaign

title_direction: working direction about every pledge being honoured
unlock_conditions: issue at least 12 guarantees, allow none to be broken, and reach Africa is one with every surviving guaranteed partner at high confidence
disqualifying_conditions: any broken guarantee, coercive annexation of a guaranteed partner, terminal high-chaos route
tracking_requirements: lifetime guarantee ledger and confidence snapshots
icon_direction: unbroken chain joining shield clasps
design_value: tests long-term reliability rather than conquest speed

title_direction: working direction about defeating a great-power expedition
unlock_conditions: defeat a foreign great-power expedition or intervention coalition on African-controlled soil while no African League member capitulates
disqualifying_conditions: member capitulation during the intervention, accepting territorial partition, forced scenario launch
tracking_requirements: intervention-war flag, member capitulation ledger, peace outcome
icon_direction: broken expedition helmet before a continental shield
design_value: rewards continental defence under the Scramble crisis

title_direction: working direction about saving a government before its capital falls
unlock_conditions: successfully evacuate leaders and archives from 3 collapsing African partners, restore all 3 governments, and keep them independent or federal members at campaign end
disqualifying_conditions: one rescued government destroyed permanently, archives sold or suppressed, direct annexation
tracking_requirements: rescue outcomes, restoration outcomes, final relationship states
icon_direction: open archive chest carried past a burning capital
design_value: makes government-in-exile and restoration play matter

title_direction: working direction about a congress that retains every delegation
unlock_conditions: hold a continental congress with at least 12 full members, conclude all agenda items, and lose no member for 365 days afterward
disqualifying_conditions: member expulsion or coerced accession during the retention period
tracking_requirements: congress attendance and post-congress membership clock
icon_direction: twelve linked chairs around a charter seal
design_value: rewards a large functioning League rather than a nominal faction

title_direction: working direction about negotiated clauses binding a continent
unlock_conditions: maintain at least 10 members with 3 or more distinct accession clauses each, resolve all clause disputes, and reach Africa is one without cancelling a protected clause
disqualifying_conditions: forced clause cancellation, untracked annexation, military order route
tracking_requirements: per-member clause count and breach ledger
icon_direction: layered charter sheets beneath linked seals
design_value: rewards detailed member bargaining and clause discipline

title_direction: working direction about surviving a peaceful secession
unlock_conditions: allow a major member to leave through negotiated terms, avoid war for 720 days, then bring it back as an associate or ally by consent
disqualifying_conditions: declaring war on the former member, coup or coerced return
tracking_requirements: departure process, peace clock, voluntary return state
icon_direction: open gate with two hands returning a seal
design_value: makes restraint and reconciliation a difficult victory

title_direction: working direction about preventing a rival League from taking root
unlock_conditions: resolve 4 rival-bloc crises through arbitration, concessions, development, or constitutional settlement, with no rival bloc surviving longer than 180 days
disqualifying_conditions: annexing the rival leader during its crisis, using terminal high-chaos coercion
tracking_requirements: rival bloc start and resolution method
icon_direction: two seals joined before a divided map line
design_value: rewards political crisis management

title_direction: working direction about every region holding a congress
unlock_conditions: complete a congress in all 9 continental regions, include at least one member from each, and settle every recorded overlap dispute
disqualifying_conditions: leaving a region without representation, unresolved overlap at Africa is one
tracking_requirements: regional congress completion, member presence, overlap ledger
icon_direction: nine small regional emblems around a speaking staff
design_value: proves that continental unity reached every region institutionally

title_direction: working direction about trust spreading from one member to another
unlock_conditions: raise 15 members to high confidence, never use coercive integration, and keep Integration Burden below the high threshold for 720 consecutive days
disqualifying_conditions: coercive integration, confidence collapse cascade, direct annexation of a member
tracking_requirements: high-confidence count, burden window, coercion lifetime flag
icon_direction: radiating member seals around a calm center
design_value: rewards patient coalition building

title_direction: working direction about a federation signed rather than imposed
unlock_conditions: form Africa through federal accession with at least 12 autonomous federal members, pass representation and fiscal settlements, and use no forced annexation
disqualifying_conditions: any forced annexation, military takeover, high-chaos covenant
tracking_requirements: formation route, member state count, lifetime coercion flag
icon_direction: linked federal seals and ballot papers
design_value: defines the hardest voluntary federal victory

title_direction: working direction about a continental republic with distributed institutions
unlock_conditions: form the continental republic, distribute at least 5 central institutions across different regions, keep elections or congress succession active, and survive 5 years
disqualifying_conditions: suspending succession, centralising all institutions in one region, military order transition
tracking_requirements: institution state placement and constitutional survival clock
icon_direction: five civic buildings linked by a republic star
design_value: rewards a republican state that does not erase regional weight

title_direction: working direction about sovereign crowns sharing one table
eligible_start: monarchical host or host that restores a monarchy
unlock_conditions: seat at least 8 recognised monarchies or restored courts, settle succession precedence, and form Africa without deposing a counted sovereign
disqualifying_conditions: forced deposition, republican abolition of counted courts, coercive annexation
tracking_requirements: recognised crown membership and deposition ledger
icon_direction: several distinct crowns around a congress table
design_value: turns monarchical federation into a genuine multi-court challenge

title_direction: working direction about labour institutions binding the continent
unlock_conditions: complete the People’s Union route, establish worker or peasant representation in 8 regions, socialise 12 major resource projects, and keep food security stable for 3 years
disqualifying_conditions: military order takeover, private concession restoration, famine failure state
tracking_requirements: regional representation, project ownership, food-security clock
icon_direction: hammer, field, and rail joined in a continental seal
design_value: links ideology to economy and survival

title_direction: working direction about a military order that still preserves the continent
unlock_conditions: form Africa through military centralisation, defeat at least 2 major foreign interventions, then reduce emergency rule and restore regional representation before campaign end
disqualifying_conditions: permanent maximum emergency rule, genocide system use against members, losing a region to partition
tracking_requirements: route state, intervention victories, demobilisation and representation flags
icon_direction: sheathed sword placed beside an opened charter
design_value: requires the coercive route to create a durable settlement

title_direction: working direction about a loose union surviving pressure
unlock_conditions: keep at least 15 sovereign members in a confederation for 10 years, win or settle the Scramble crisis, and never raise central integration above the confederal ceiling
disqualifying_conditions: federal annexation, member cascade, central integration ceiling breach
tracking_requirements: sovereign-member count, time window, route ceiling
icon_direction: loose ring of flags around a shared shield
design_value: makes the least central route a demanding end state

title_direction: working direction about a constitutional order that includes impossible actors
unlock_conditions: form a constitutional order including at least 3 clearly nonhuman or supernatural members, pass rights and obligation clauses, and prevent all 3 from entering hostile rampage state for 5 years
disqualifying_conditions: enslavement or extermination of counted actors, hostile rampage, terminal disease failure
tracking_requirements: actor membership, clause passage, rampage and survival timers
icon_direction: human charter seal joined to forest, stone, and animal emblems
design_value: rewards governance of high-chaos content rather than simple exploitation

title_direction: working direction about Luba, Lunda, Kuba, and related courts sharing a settlement
eligible_start: any host or relevant restored polity
unlock_conditions: restore Luba, Lunda, and Kuba, keep all three alive, settle their overlapping claims, and place them in one League or federation
disqualifying_conditions: annexing one before settlement, unresolved overlap, destroying a court
tracking_requirements: specific polity existence, overlap settlement, relationship state
icon_direction: three distinct court regalia motifs joined without overlap
design_value: uses researched Central African state traditions as political actors

title_direction: working direction about several Nile inheritances finding a settlement
unlock_conditions: restore or recognise at least 3 among Kush, Nubia, Makuria, and Alodia, resolve all overlapping claims, and complete a shared Nile corridor
disqualifying_conditions: one claimant directly erases another, corridor failure, unresolved capital dispute
tracking_requirements: specific polity set, claims settlement, corridor completion
icon_direction: river, crown, and church or court silhouettes in layers
design_value: turns overlap into negotiation rather than release spam

title_direction: working direction about Swahili ports forming a maritime federation
eligible_start: East African, island, or coastal host
unlock_conditions: bring at least 6 Swahili coast or island polities into one maritime federation, connect 5 ports, and maintain convoy access for 3 years
disqualifying_conditions: losing 2 counted ports, direct inland military annexation as formation shortcut
tracking_requirements: polity membership, port network, convoy-access clock
icon_direction: dhow sail linking six port seals
design_value: rewards the coast as a trade network

title_direction: working direction about Harar, Aksum, and inland corridors
unlock_conditions: keep Aksum and Harar as recognised packages, connect them to Red Sea and inland corridors, and settle their constitutional status without war between them
disqualifying_conditions: war between counted polities, forced abolition, corridor loss for a year
tracking_requirements: specific polities, corridor state, bilateral peace
icon_direction: fortified wall and stela beside a caravan
design_value: supports distinct Horn political identities

title_direction: working direction about Great Zimbabwe, Mutapa, Rozwi, and Khami
unlock_conditions: restore or recognise 3 southern plateau polities, connect mines to locally controlled processing, and prevent foreign concession control for 5 years
disqualifying_conditions: foreign concession majority, direct annexation before settlement, mine corridor failure
tracking_requirements: specific polity set, project ownership, time window
icon_direction: stone enclosure, gold, and rail motif
design_value: links restoration to resource sovereignty

title_direction: working direction about a restored polity defeating the unifier without abandoning continental politics
eligible_start: start as or switch to a Tier A restored polity created by Event 12
unlock_conditions: refuse integration, form or lead a rival bloc with 4 members, defeat or compel settlement with the unifier, then establish a recognised African confederation
disqualifying_conditions: joining a non-African colonial faction as a puppet, destroying all League institutions, terminal world-end route
tracking_requirements: origin tracking, rival leadership, war outcome, final confederation
icon_direction: small restored seal standing before a larger broken chain
design_value: gives restored members a full alternate campaign

title_direction: working direction about voluntary return completed with trust intact
unlock_conditions: receive 8 successful voluntary return waves from at least 4 origin countries, keep Diaspora Trust high, provide citizenship or protected status, and have no forced relocation
disqualifying_conditions: forced relocation, transport disaster caused by negligence, discriminatory settlement failure
tracking_requirements: wave origins, consent, trust, rights, relocation flags
icon_direction: ship and train carrying families toward an open civic gate
design_value: rewards the requested diaspora route under strict safeguards

title_direction: working direction about returnees building institutions
unlock_conditions: complete skilled return programmes in education, medicine, engineering, and public administration, establish political representation, and finish 12 local projects
disqualifying_conditions: using returnees only as military labour, denying representation, trust collapse
tracking_requirements: programme categories, project count, representation flag
icon_direction: book, medical bag, wrench, and ballot around a passport
design_value: makes return a social and institutional system

title_direction: working direction about routes arriving from several shores
unlock_conditions: complete safe return or investment links from North America, South America or Caribbean, Europe, and an Indian Ocean origin, with no route suffering catastrophic loss
disqualifying_conditions: missing one origin group, any catastrophic transport failure, forced scenario launch
tracking_requirements: origin-region flags and route outcome ledger
icon_direction: four route lines converging on a port and rail hub
design_value: requires a genuinely global network

title_direction: working direction about diaspora investment without political seizure
unlock_conditions: fund 10 locally controlled projects using diaspora investment, keep local ownership above the protected threshold, and prevent any foreign or diaspora faction from capturing the Charter government
disqualifying_conditions: privatisation below threshold, foreign capture, corruption crisis unresolved
tracking_requirements: project ownership, influence ceiling, government-capture flags
icon_direction: coin and factory held within an open hand
design_value: rewards investment without replacing one dependency with another

title_direction: working direction about all four corridor systems connecting the continent
unlock_conditions: complete at least one major rail, river, road, and port corridor in every applicable region, connect all 9 regions to the continental network, and keep access open for 2 years
disqualifying_conditions: network split into two disconnected components, losing all access to one region
tracking_requirements: network graph, mode coverage, connection timer
icon_direction: rail, river, road, and port crossing one continental seal
design_value: rewards infrastructure as the real foundation of unity

title_direction: working direction about resources processed before export
unlock_conditions: control or partner in 12 major resource zones, establish local processing for each, and keep foreign concession share below the cap for 5 years
disqualifying_conditions: raw-export dependency crisis, concession share cap breach, forced seizure without settlement
tracking_requirements: resource zone and processing pairs, ownership clock
icon_direction: ore entering a furnace and leaving as machinery
design_value: connects resources to industry rather than flat bonuses

title_direction: working direction about food security preceding final unification
unlock_conditions: reach high food security in all 9 regions before Africa is one, survive one major drought or famine without regional collapse, and maintain emergency reserves
disqualifying_conditions: forming Africa before the food threshold, preventable famine collapse, maximum ecological wrath used against civilians
tracking_requirements: regional food values, disaster outcome, reserve state
icon_direction: grain store and water channel beneath a folded banner
design_value: makes civilian survival a prerequisite for the grand fantasy

title_direction: working direction about continental development with manageable burden
unlock_conditions: complete 30 development projects across all regions while keeping Integration Burden below the high threshold and no region below medium confidence for 720 days
disqualifying_conditions: burden threshold breach, region confidence collapse, project exploitation scandal
tracking_requirements: project ledger, burden and confidence windows
icon_direction: balanced scales holding factory and village motifs
design_value: rewards growth that does not destroy the League

title_direction: working direction about a reserve army arriving where promised
unlock_conditions: activate the common reserve in 6 distinct defensive wars, meet every deployment deadline, and lose no protected capital while the reserve is active
disqualifying_conditions: missed deployment deadline, protected capital loss, offensive abuse of reserve
tracking_requirements: war targets, deployment deadlines, capital control
icon_direction: reserve standard planted before six shield marks
design_value: turns shared defence into an operational system

title_direction: working direction about removing every hostile expedition from Africa
unlock_conditions: win a Scramble coalition war, remove every hostile non-African controlled state on the continent, and sign peace without ceding an African core region
disqualifying_conditions: ceding an African core region, member capitulation that is not reversed, terminal external puppet status
tracking_requirements: coalition war, continent control, peace treaty state
icon_direction: empty foreign bootprint beside a continental spear and shield
design_value: serves as the major conventional military capstone

title_direction: working direction about clearly nonhuman formations serving beside human armies
unlock_conditions: field 4 different clearly nonhuman or supernatural unit families, win a great-power war, and preserve rights clauses for their associated actors
disqualifying_conditions: using a human ethnic caricature unit, exterminating associated actor, rights clause removal
tracking_requirements: unit-family combat participation, actor rights, war victory
icon_direction: four impossible silhouettes beneath a constitutional standard
design_value: rewards the safe and explicit nonhuman framing

title_direction: working direction about an absurd logistics formation completing an impossible campaign
unlock_conditions: create an elephant logistics or shock formation, move it through at least 3 terrain regions including desert, keep supply above the minimum, and use it in a victorious protection war
disqualifying_conditions: unit destroyed before victory, unsupplied attrition failure, use against an unthreatened African state
tracking_requirements: unit identity, terrain history, supply, war purpose
icon_direction: armoured elephant beside rail and water drums
design_value: uses an absurd unit as a logistical challenge rather than a joke alone

title_direction: working direction about completing a bargain with a living forest
unlock_conditions: make and honour 5 ecological bargains, avert or contain 3 disasters, and keep Ecological Wrath below the rampage threshold for 5 years
disqualifying_conditions: breaking a bargain, weaponising disaster against civilians, forest actor rampage
tracking_requirements: bargain ledger, disaster outcomes, wrath clock
icon_direction: living canopy forming a protective arch
design_value: rewards restraint in the nature system

title_direction: working direction about a weather power winning without destroying its own land
unlock_conditions: use supernatural weather against 3 hostile colonial or intervention armies, win each campaign, and cause no maximum-tier disaster in a member state
disqualifying_conditions: maximum-tier member disaster, use against neutral African state, wrath collapse
tracking_requirements: weather action targets, campaign outcomes, disaster severity
icon_direction: storm cloud held above enemy ships by an oracle staff
design_value: tests targeted high-chaos warfare

title_direction: working direction about containing a disease created by the same route
unlock_conditions: create or unlock a route-specific disease, suffer an accidental or enemy outbreak, contain every infected state, develop countermeasures, and end with zero active outbreak states
disqualifying_conditions: deliberate uncontrolled civilian release, irreversible contamination, outbreak reaching terminal world-end state
tracking_requirements: disease source, outbreak states, countermeasure and cleanup
icon_direction: sealed vial beside a restored green leaf
design_value: requires responsibility and recovery from dangerous content

title_direction: working direction about a living-statue actor entering constitutional government
unlock_conditions: recognise a living-statue state, negotiate representation and obligations, include it in the constitutional order, and prevent war between it and human members for 5 years
disqualifying_conditions: enslavement, forced dismantling, war with a human member, actor erasure
tracking_requirements: actor recognition, seats, peace clock
icon_direction: stone figure seated beside a charter tablet
design_value: turns an impossible actor into constitutional gameplay

title_direction: working direction about sponsoring a second continent-scale movement
unlock_conditions: successfully sponsor one other continent unifier from opening movement to full continental identity, keep it allied or friendly for 5 years, and avoid puppeting it
disqualifying_conditions: sponsored movement collapses, direct puppet status, betrayal caused by broken sponsorship clauses
tracking_requirements: sponsorship stages, final identity, relations clock
icon_direction: two distinct continent emblems linked by an open bridge
design_value: rewards long-term foreign system play

title_direction: working direction about a readable two-continent union
unlock_conditions: form a valid two-continent union through negotiation, complete constitutional and military integration, and keep both continental regions above medium confidence for 5 years
disqualifying_conditions: forming through conquest-only annexation, regional confidence collapse, union civil war
tracking_requirements: partner identity, union method, regional confidence clock
icon_direction: two continent silhouettes within one simple crown or civic seal
design_value: tests the dynamic union route under stability constraints

title_direction: working direction about defeating another continent-scale power
eligible_start: unified Africa or valid Africa-led union
unlock_conditions: defeat a rival continent-scale power in a terminal continental war, complete a sustainable settlement, and avoid global revolt for 3 years
disqualifying_conditions: using a debug surrender, settlement left incomplete, global revolt threshold reached
tracking_requirements: rival identity, war result, settlement, revolt clock
icon_direction: two large continental emblems separated by a broken spear
design_value: marks the ultimate non-terminal military struggle

title_direction: working direction about the final terminal identity
unlock_conditions: become the last eligible continent-scale power, resolve every rival through union, federation, submission, or victory, form The World, and trigger the terminal super-event
disqualifying_conditions: another world-end state already active, forced scenario launch, invalid unresolved continent identity
tracking_requirements: continent identity ledger, world_end flags, formation event
icon_direction: single globe-scale seal with all continent motifs reduced to one readable mark
design_value: is the rare campaign-ending capstone requested by the brief
